a field of battle~bitter #2 is Disc 2, Track 6 on the Xenosaga II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse ~Movie Scene Soundtrack~. AP for All! is the third skill in 's Flexibility skill branch. It adds a new option to Yoink!, where instead of doing what it normally does, it provides the party with half of the that the target foe would normally grant when killed.

is a track in Xenosaga Episode III. It has not been released on any soundtrack or sound selection and not much is known about this track. It plays as the area theme in Abel's Ark, as well as the following cutscenes: * MOMO detects the Zohar Emulators' waveforms from the spheres surrounding Abel's Ark's core. * Natus Lumen, Natus Tellus, Natus Flamma, and Natus Glacies materialise between the Zohar Emulators. * The Zohar Emulators vanish after the defeat of the above bosses. * The party's E.S.s resonate with the after the defeat of all four of the above bosses.

a memory of a tragedy is Disc 2, Track 3 on the Xenosaga III: Also Sprach Zarathustra Original Sound Best Tracks album. Its melody is based upon a motif from a prelude to the tragedy. It plays as the area music on Michtam for all areas before the , as well as the following cutscenes: * The party steps out of the Elsa onto Michtam. * Ziggy reveals that he fought Voyager on Michtam (when it was called Abraxas). * The party sees the remains of people attacked by Gnosis on Michtam.

It plays during Kevin's farewell to Shion after Zarathustra is defeated. is a remix of a new world. It does not play in Xenosaga Episode III - it was stored within the game's files but went unused.

100-Series Observational Units, also referred to as 100-Series Realians, are a subcategory of Observational Realians in the Xenosaga series immediately following the experimental Kirschwasser test bodies. A.M.W.S. (pronounced "aims"), short for Assault Maneuver Weapon System, are humanoid mobile weapons from the Xenosaga series.

.]] A.G.W.S. (pronounced "eggs"), short for Anti-Gnosis Weapon System, are manned mobile weapons from the Xenosaga series. As the name implies, A.G.W.S. units are deployed as a measure to combat the Gnosis phenomenon. As such, they are designed at a smaller scale than their multi-purpose counterpart, the A.M.W.S. units, at about 4-5 meters tall to account for the Gnosis' range of mobility. Additionally, each A.G.W.S. unit is equipped with a D.S.S.S. sensor. As a tradeoff to their size, they cannot be fitted with internal engines, much less a Vessel of Anima. ANÚNA is an Irish vocal group. They have been involved in a number of recordings and performances of music from the Xeno series, in particular that of Yasunori Mitsuda. They contributed to the music of Xenoblade Chronicles 2 and official arrangements from the music of Xenogears, and their members performed for the music of Xenoblade Chronicles 3.

A.G.W.S. 2 is the fourth multiplayer level in Xeno-pittan's alternating turn mode. It is a board in the shape of two A.G.W.S. mechs with the characters え and い on the first mech, and ぐ and す on the second mech. Combined, they make the word , meaning A.G.W.S. The objective is to be the first to take 20 squares (out of a total of 62).

.]] A.G.W.S. Battle is a mini game in Xenosaga Episode I - Der Wille zur Macht. The player must get the Battle Passport from the KOS-MOS Simulator after revisiting it in the EVS, then use it at a save point with EVS functionality to play this game. This mode involves controlling A.G.W.S. mechs in battle against each other. This mode is strictly for fun; no rewards are given on win or loss.

-MYTH- The Xenogears Orchestral Album is an album comprised of orchestral arrangements of 14 tracks from the Xenogears Original Soundtrack, released on a single disc in February 2011. A vinyl version of the album with 6 selected tracks was released in April 2011. Arrangements were done by Yasunori Mitsuda, Youki Yamamoto, Sachiko Miyano, and Natsumi Kameoka. The performance was recorded at the Bulgarian National Radio Hall, done by the [https://www.sif309.com/sif309 Bulgarian Symphony Orchestra]. Across the Kosmos ~ Xenosaga Piano Collection is an album consisting of piano arrangements of the music of Xenosaga Episode I, performed by Benyamin Nuss and arranged by Mariam Abounnasr, Akio Noguchi, Benyamin Nuss, and Hiroyuki Nakayama. The album was produced by Wayô Records and was announced on the 11th of March, 2024. It was released alongside a companion jazz album, Across the Kosmos ~ Jazz in Kosmos, featuring music from the same soundtrack arranged and performed by Endgegner. The album was first released digitally to Kickstarter backers on the 10th of September, 2025. A concert performance of the pieces from the album took place on the 29th of November, 2025 in Paris, France.
